{{Short description|13th season of top-tier Turkish football}}
The following are the statistics of the '''[[Süper Lig|Turkish First Football League]]''' for the 1970–71 season.

==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams, and [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray S.K.]] won the championship.
